Munsiyari & Khaliya Top

A Kumaon journey from the temple village of Kasar Devi to Munsiyari and the Khaliya Top trek, with Himalayan views. A 4-day group trip from Delhi.

THE TRIP

About the Munsiyari Khaliya Top Trip

Munsiyari sits in the far east of Kumaon, facing the Panchachuli peaks. This trip starts at Kasar Devi, a hilltop temple village with cafés and valley views, and passes Kainchi Dham, Jageshwar and Birthi Falls on the way.

The main walk is the 5 km trek to Khaliya Top through pine forests and meadows, where you spend the night in forest huts or tents under open skies. An optional extension to Zero Point gives views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha.

START & END
Delhi
STAY
Hotel & camps, 3 nights
MEALS
3 breakfasts & 3 dinners
TRANSPORT
AC coach, Delhi to Delhi
WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Kainchi Dham — a temple stop on the way to Almora.

Kasar Devi — a hilltop temple village with cafés and sunset views.

Jageshwar Dham — an ancient temple complex in a deodar forest.

Birthi Falls — a tall waterfall about 126 m high.

Khaliya Top trek — about 5 km one way through pine forests and meadows.

Zero Point (optional) — views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha.

Night at Khaliya Top — forest huts or tents, with sunset and sunrise views.

Bonfire & music — a light music evening with the group.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Departure: Depart from Delhi in the evening. Your pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.
  • Ice-breaker: Start with an ice-breaking session and get to know your co-travellers.
  • Overnight journey: Travel overnight towards Kasar Devi.
  • Arrival: Check in to your stay on arrival, freshen up and relax after the journey.
  • Kainchi Dham: On the way to Almora, visit the Kainchi Dham temple.
  • Kasar Devi Temple: Visit the hilltop Kasar Devi Temple.
  • Village walk: Walk through the local lanes and visit the boho cafés.
  • Sunset: Watch a peaceful sunset over the Kumaon valley.
  • Night: Return to your stay for dinner and overnight stay.
  • Morning: Have breakfast, then begin the scenic drive to Munsiyari.
  • Golu Devta: Stop at the Golu Devta temple.
  • Jageshwar Dham: Visit the ancient Jageshwar temple complex.
  • Sama Village: Optional short scenic halt.
  • Birthi Falls: Stop at the tall Birthi waterfall, about 126 m high, for photographs.
  • Munsiyari: Check in and relax. Optionally explore the Nanda Devi Temple, Thamri Kund or the local market.
  • Night: Dinner and overnight stay in Munsiyari.
  • Start: After breakfast, begin the trek from Balati Bend. You can visit the Nanda Devi Temple at the start of the trek.
  • Trail: About 5 km one way, 2.5 to 3 hours, through pine forests and meadows.
  • Khaliya Top: Reach Khaliya Top and rest in forest huts or tents.
  • Zero Point: Optionally trek further to Zero Point for views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha.
  • Night: Sunset views, a warm dinner and overnight stay at Khaliya Top.
  • Sunrise: Watch the sunrise over snow-capped peaks.
  • Descent: After breakfast, trek down to Munsiyari.
  • Departure: Start the return journey to Delhi by afternoon.
  • Arrival: Reach Delhi late at night or early the next morning (tentatively around 6:00 AM).
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Delhi to Delhi transportation by AC coach
  • 3 nights accommodation in hotel and camps
  • Meals: 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners
  • The Trip Captain with the group at all times
  • All required permits
  • Driver allowance, toll taxes and state taxes
  • Bonfire and light music night

Not included in your package

  • Any extra meals apart from those mentioned in the inclusions
  • Cost of snow chains or a 4x4 vehicle if needed due to heavy snowfall
  • Travel insurance and personal items such as porterage, tips and laundry
  • Entry fees and optional activities, room heaters or tickets unless listed in the inclusions
  • Extra costs due to natural calamity, weather, roadblocks, landslides or other circumstances beyond our control
  • Anything not mentioned in the inclusions
